Round 3: Seyi PASSed round 2 outright (SY-OPS009-01/02 fully closed). Femi's round-2 re-review found FEMI-OPS009-01 only partially closed (REVIEW-Femi-round2.md): the round-2 fix correctly covered the archive command returning a nonzero exit code, but backup-azurite.sh installed no EXIT/INT/TERM trap - a SIGINT/SIGTERM delivered between docker stop and the restart later in the script left Azurite stopped with no restart ever attempted. The round-2 live test only forced a nonzero mkdir/archive exit, never an actual signal, so it didn't catch this.

Fix: trap restart_on_exit_if_not_already_confirmed EXIT (+ trap 'exit N' INT/TERM, same reasoning as SY-OPS009-02's fix) installed before the container is ever stopped, so a signal at any point from then on is covered. A container_restart_confirmed flag disarms the handler once the normal restart path has confirmed readiness, so the happy path does no redundant work.

Verified live: sent a real SIGTERM to the backup process immediately after its docker stop log line (well before the script's own restart code could run) - the trap caught it, restarted Azurite, and confirmed it healthy before the process exited.
